epics.name: Home
epics.hint: Home tab (route /): dashboard widgets, program cards, KPI tiles.

epics.name: Value Streams
epics.hint: Value Streams tab (routes /overview, /value-streams, /n/...): map/list views, Inspector side panel, process hierarchy L3/L4/L5.

epics.name: Organization
epics.hint: Organization tab (routes /organization, /divisions, /departments): org map/list, divisions, departments.

epics.name: Roles
epics.hint: Roles tab (route /roles): role catalog, role detail, role associations.

epics.name: Deliverables
epics.hint: Deliverables tab (routes /deliverables, /work): deliverable list, search, columns, detail drill-down.

epics.name: Standards
epics.hint: Standards tab (route /standards): standards catalog, drilldowns, agent skills.

epics.name: Regulations
epics.hint: Regulations tab (route /regulations): requirements, compliance rules, coverage, monitored sources.

epics.name: Tasks
epics.hint: Tasks tab (route /tasks): task list, search, columns, per-task AI automatability.

epics.name: Applications
epics.hint: Applications tab (route /applications): app portfolio, TCO, vendors.

epics.name: Third-Parties
epics.hint: Third-Parties tab (route /external): external parties and interactions.

epics.name: Workspace
epics.hint: Workspace tab (routes /portfolio, /programs, /initiatives, /raid): programs, initiatives, RAID, benefits/costs.

epics.name: Approvals
epics.hint: Approvals tab (route /approvals): approval queues and routing.

epics.name: Work Library
epics.hint: Work Library tab (route /work-library): work plan templates, assignments, chains.

epics.name: Metrics
epics.hint: Metrics tab (route /metrics): AI adoption stages, rollups, trackable metrics.

epics.name: Automatable
epics.hint: Automatable tab (route /automatable): automatability snapshot, rollups, value/complexity views.

epics.name: Data Admin
epics.hint: Data Admin tab (routes /admin, /audit): configure, trackable metrics, audit log, data dictionary.

epics.name: User Admin
epics.hint: User Admin tab (route /user-admin): users, user types & permissions, API keys.

epics.name: Performance
epics.hint: General: slowness, load times, timeouts, rendering performance — regardless of which tab it was reported on.

epics.name: Platform UX & Reliability
epics.hint: General: cross-cutting UI/UX, auth/session errors, dialogs, filters, the feedback widget itself — anything spanning multiple tabs.

epics.name: New Functionality
epics.hint: General: requests for new capabilities that do not belong to a single existing tab (e.g. AI/human process tagging, segmentation by line of business/region).

epics.name: Business Case & Stakeholder Communication
epics.hint: General: elevator pitch, business case, benefits/investment materials, stakeholder messaging (not app features).
